# Zoho Books

**Zoho publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Zoho publishes its own Zoho Books plugin, built for Google Antigravity rather than Claude; it is indexed because it shows what the hosted server can do. In Claude, connect Zoho's hosted Books server directly. The plugin confirms every create, update, email and match with you first.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://books.zohomcp.com/mcp/message** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Zoho Books account. Zoho's global Books server, named in Zoho's own plugin. Can create invoices, bills and journals and record payments.
